headline_marked: 16 Bangladeshis [[killed in Saudi sofa factory fire]]
headline: 16 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi sofa factory fire
summary: Thirteen of the deceased workers were from Naogaon district, leaving families in deep mourning.
details: A devastating fire at a sofa factory in Manfu, Saudi Arabia, has claimed the lives of 16 Bangladeshi workers.
Reports indicate that 13 of the victims were residents of the Naogaon district, highlighting the heavy toll on a single community.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has expressed her deep mourning and condolences over the tragic loss of these citizens.
Other high-ranking officials, including Khalilur Rahman Kabir and Shama Chowdhury, have also shared their grief over the incident.
The tragedy has left numerous families in Bangladesh in shock and mourning as they await further details regarding the victims.
caption:
16 Bangladeshi workers killed in a factory fire in Saudi Arabia. 13 of them were from Naogaon.

A devastating fire at a sofa factory in Manfu, Saudi Arabia, has claimed the lives of 16 Bangladeshi workers.

Reports indicate that 13 of the victims were residents of the Naogaon district, highlighting the heavy toll on a single community.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has expressed her deep mourning and condolences over the tragic loss of these citizens.

Other high-ranking officials, including Khalilur Rahman Kabir and Shama Chowdhury, have also shared their grief over the incident.

The tragedy has left numerous families in Bangladesh in shock and mourning as they await further details regarding the victims.

#SaudiArabia #Bangladesh #Tragedy #MigrantWorkers #Naogaon

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo

headline: Dhaka urges India to expedite Hasina's extradition and return Hadi's killers
summary: Bangladesh has requested Indian cooperation in the extradition of former PM Sheikh Hasina and the return of those responsible for the killing of Hadi
details: Bangladesh has called upon India to speed up the extradition process for former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. The request was made during a high-level meeting between the interim government and the Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi.
caption:
Bangladesh asks India for the extradition of Sheikh Hasina and the return of Hadi's killers.

Bangladesh has called upon India to speed up the extradition process for former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. The request was made during a high-level meeting between the interim government and the Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi.
